policies.name: Routine Low-Value Auto-Resolution
policies.description: Refund requests under or equal to $50.00 for verified customers with low historical risk score (<=0.25) and no more than 1 refund in the past 30 days qualify for routine processing without managerial sign-off.

policies.name: Standard Dispute Single-Signoff
policies.description: Claims between $50.01 and $250.00, or claims from accounts with moderate risk scores (<=0.50), mandate review and cryptographic digital authorization by one certified Approver.

policies.name: High-Value Four-Eyes Dual-Authorization
policies.description: Refund claims between $250.01 and $1,500.00, or involving sensitive high-risk merchandise, strictly mandate dual independent authorization under the Four-Eyes principle. The two approvers must be distinct individuals, with the final signoff provided by a Senior Approver or Administrator.

policies.name: Tier Decline Hard-Limit & Fraud Exclusion
policies.description: Claims exceeding $1,500.00, claims on accounts less than 7 days old exceeding $200.00, customers with chronic dispute flags (>3 recent refunds or risk >0.70), or suspicious fraud patterns are strictly barred from refund approval. System automatically enforces Tier Decline.

policies.name: Time-Barred Purchase Window Exclusion
policies.description: Claims initiated more than 60 days following the transaction date are time-barred by statutory terms of service and must be declined.
